title: Figuren-Test · 8 Trickfilm-Figuren laden, pruefen und Probebilder rendern

steps.label: Start, Systemcheck
steps.run: echo start; date -u; memory_pressure -Q 2>/dev/null | tail -1; pgrep -fl Blender | head -3; df -h ~ | tail -1; true

steps.label: Skripte schreiben
Kandidaten auswaehlen
steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup -P sel.py -- "$AGENT_HOME/work/2501-char-probe"/probe/results.json 8 cands.txt > sel.log 2>&1 < /dev/null; grep pool sel.log; cat cands.txt; UAL=$(find "$AGENT_HOME/work/2501-char-probe"/ual/universal_animation_librarystandard -iname '*.glb' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -S 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$UAL" ] && UAL=$(find "$AGENT_HOME/work/2501-char-probe"/ual -iname '*.glb' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -S 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "$UAL" > ual_path.txt; cat ual_path.txt; test -s cands.txt

steps.label: Figuren laden, pruefen, Probebilder (je eigener Blender)
steps.run: mkdir -p cands; UAL=$(cat ual_path.txt); while read tag id url; do T=$(date +%s); /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P cand.py -- $tag $id $url $PWD/cands "$UAL" > cands/$tag.log 2>&1 < /dev/null; echo "$tag $id $(( $(date +%s) - T )) s: $(grep CAND cands/$tag.log | tail -1)"; done < cands.txt; ls cands | head -50; true

steps.label: Ergebnisse fuer Claude bereitstellen
steps.run: tar czf cands2502.tgz cands cands.txt sel.log ual_path.txt && ls -la cands2502.tgz && "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" cands2502.tgz 2502/cands2502.tgz
